extraction_notes: Main-text performance figures digitised: Figure 2A–C, Figure 6A–D, and Figure 7A. Figure 5D shows TOF values, but the provided record schema has no TOF/rate field; those plotted TOF bars were therefore not encoded as catalyst-performance records. Characterisation figures/panels (Figures 1, 3, 4, 5A–C, 7B–D, 8) were skipped. All plotted numerical values are approximate digitised values with qualifier '~', except qualitative CH4 annotations such as n.d. or less than 0.1% are recorded as bounds/null where appropriate.
